content.text: {"evidence":[{"note":"Directly studies zero-shot link prediction on unseen knowledge graphs using vanilla GNNs.","paper":"P46"},{"note":"Uses GraphSAGE backbone for directed link prediction; standard GNN link prediction on graphs.","paper":"P36"},{"note":"Evaluates GNNs on KG link prediction with continual updates, but not unknown graphs specifically.","paper":"P3"},{"note":"Improves knowledge graph completion with structural priors; standard GNNs not central, and no unseen-graph focus.","paper":"P29"},{"note":"Reviews KG embeddings for link prediction; background only, not about standard GNNs on unknown KGs.","paper":"P9"},{"note":"Benchmarks GNN-based link prediction on knowledge graphs at scale, relevant but not unknown-graph transfer.","paper":"P48"},{"note":"Discusses zero-shot generalization on unseen KGs, but focuses on KG foundation models, not standard GNNs.","paper":"P24"},{"note":"Studies link prediction under KG incompleteness, using embeddings plus LLM reasoning rather than standard GNNs.","paper":"P45"},{"note":"Explores link prediction on unseen knowledge graphs in a generalization setting, though with reified representations.","paper":"P46"},{"note":"Survey-style overview of GNN applications, including knowledge graphs; too broad for the specific question.","paper":"P12"}],"ranking":["P46","P36","P3","P29","P9","P48","P24","P45","P46","P12","P1","P2","P4","P5","P6","P7","P8","P10","P11","P13","P14","P15","P16","P17","P18","P19","P20","P21","P22","P23","P25","P26","P27","P28","P30","P31","P32","P33","P34","P35","P37","P38","P39","P40","P41","P42","P43","P44","P47","P49","P50"]}
